purpose: Versioned documentation of methodology-critical heuristics used by current final evidence. This file makes implementation-defined rules auditable without changing protected evidence.

task_strata.description: Scenario-name and category based task-family classification used for cohort quality, expected helper fit, and gap reports.
task_strata.status: protocol-defined heuristic, not independent benchmark label

helper_fit_taxonomy.no_current_helper_fit_definition: A task is marked no-current-helper-fit when no expected helper from the taxonomy intersects with retained tools loaded for the scenario; if no helpers are loaded, it falls back to whether the taxonomy expects any helper at all.
helper_fit_taxonomy.interpretation: No-current-helper-fit can indicate no expected helper, helper hidden, or helper absent from the current registry; it is a coverage proxy, not proof that no useful tool could exist.

routing.final_run_evidence_policy: Final frozen runs must set routing evidence to disabled or pinned; mtime-selected latest helper-contribution evidence is diagnostic/discovery behavior only.

cohort_quality.principle: Block low-diversity, near-duplicate-dominated, or contaminated cohorts unless an explicit diagnostic override is used.

protocol_gate_vs_final_claim.old_protocol_gate: Absolute +0.08 outcome/canonical-style gate used in earlier campaign automation.
protocol_gate_vs_final_claim.final_claim_criteria: Outcome/task-completion is primary; relative task-completion lift and paired comparisons are reported, canonical/reference similarity is secondary, and safety must remain clean.

generated_tool_adoption.interpretation: Accepted-but-uncalled, visible-not-called, or force-call-only tools are blocker diagnoses. They must not be collapsed into no-value conclusions without routing, schema, affordance, callability, safety, and value evidence.

bridge_policy.activation: Feature-flagged Praxis combined treatment uses SAGE_PRAXIS_BRIDGE_POLICY=combined.
bridge_policy.scope: General actor/checker policy that improves natural adoption of retained helpers, preserves final answers after helper calls, clarifies safe scalar arguments, treats original state-setter None returns as success, and audits helper side-effect preservation using trace and conversation-visible tool calls.
bridge_policy.integrity_boundary: Bridge policy is part of the tested SAGE treatment when enabled. It must be documented as a registry plus actor/checker bridge-policy treatment, not as registry-only value. It does not force tool calls, inspect labels, use expected answers, or select scenarios.

cache_policy.openai_response_cache: Provider response cache controlled separately by scripts/run_sage_protocol.py --cache-mode.
cache_policy.task_level_control_cache: Control arm may reuse eligible task-level baseline records with >=3 compatible completed controls; cached controls are score-complete, but synthetic rows may be trace-incomplete unless historical trajectories are available.
